The Resource is responsible for EHR and other clinical use applications support within and outside the EHR to physician providers, clinicians and all applicable staff on-site across the UCI enterprise including multiple healthcare facilities and specialty ambulatory clinics. The Resource will address clinical support issues, deliver training, and assist providers with EHR workflows to enhance efficiency and compliance. Additionally, this role will provide at-the-elbow support and training tools that connect with the EHR to drive provider efficiency, proficiency, and compliance.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite
At least three (3) years of Epic training and support
Must demonstrate customer service skills appropriate to the job
Knowledge of University and medical center organizations, policies, procedures and forms
Independent problem-solving skills and the ability to multi-task in a fast paced environment
In-depth understanding of Epic functionality and workflows
Familiarity with Epic modules such as COPE, Ambulatory, OpTime, Anesthesia, Stork, Cupid, Healthy Planet, ASAP, ClinDoc, Kaleidoscope, and others
Excellent presentation and communication skills, both in one-to-one and group settings
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail
An understanding of AI in the healthcare setting
Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, nights, weekends and holidays
Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships across the Health System
Ability to apply logical troubleshooting and analysis techniques for the purpose of problem resolution
Ability to adapt to and train providers on organization-specific workflows
